import sys

input = sys.stdin.read().split()
T = int(input[0])
i = 1
results = []

for _ in range(T):
    X = int(input[i])
    Y = int(input[i + 1])
    i += 2
    diff = abs(X - Y)
    if diff % 2 == 0:
        results.append(2 if diff > 0 else 0)
    else:
        results.append(1)

print("\n".join(map(str, results)))
